title: FNPrp
description: FNPRP adds a fully functional, stackable currency system to Minecraft, designed specifically for roleplay servers and political/economic simulations.
body:
FNPRP – Real Economy for Roleplay
FNPRP adds a fully functional, stackable currency system to Minecraft, designed specifically for roleplay servers and political/economic simulations.

This mod introduces two distinct, tradeable in-game currencies:

Russian Rubles (₽) – RUB

US Dollars ($) – USD


RP-Optimized – Perfect for nation-servers, city-RP, post-apocalyptic economies, or any server that needs believable money.
No Dependencies – Works standalone. No other mods required.
Stackable – Standard 64-stack. Manage your wealth in bulk.

This mod is not affiliated with any real-world financial system. All currency designs are fictional and made for roleplay purposes.
